text:
mia (marketing): Heads up — we need final changelog + docs links for Tuesday AM announcement. Can engineering confirm rollout window and whether any endpoints change?
kevin (eng): Working on final changelog now. No API surface changes, just perf flags and a new quantized variant.
sophie (docs): I can draft the docs page as soon as I have the changelog + sample curl. ETA today EOD?
mia (marketing): EOD would be perfect. We need links for the blog, the email, and the release notes page. Also planning a 30-min webinar Wed 11am PT — want a short demo of the perf improvements.
grant (product): Webinar sounds good. Can we get a short benchmark summary to put in the blog: latency p50/p95 and cost delta for common prompt?
kevin (eng): I'll paste a short bench snippet here in a sec. We ran 128-token gen on rwd-4-small-quant: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, ~28% token-cost reduction vs baseline. Will include config used.
olivia (growth): For inbound routing — once blog goes live, route convos to sales@redwood and tag "bench-interest" in Drift. Can ops set up a simple lead template?
sophie (docs): Drafting docs at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/rwd-4-quant (placeholder). Will update with curl + config.
kevin (eng): Changelog draft: 
```
- Added quantized rwd-4 variant (4-bit) with ~28% cost reduction
- Improved KV-cache recall path to reduce repeat-prefix latency
- Exposed new `perf_mode` flag for continuous batching tuning
```
kevin (eng): Sample curl for docs: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small-quant","input":"Write a haiku","max_tokens":128}'
```
mia (marketing): Perfect — Sophie, can you link that curl and the changelog in the final blog draft?
sophie (docs): Yep. Also adding an "Upgrade notes" section: no breaking changes, just optional `model` name bump if you want quantized cost.
grant (product): Rollout timing: engineering ok to do canary Mon night, full traffic Tue 4am PT?
kevin (eng): Canary Mon 23:30 PT -> 10% traffic. Monitor error rate & latency dashboards. Full ramp Tue 04:00 PT if no regressions.
mia (marketing): That works for PR timeline. Blog embargo: please keep internal lock until Tue 08:00 PT.
kevin (eng): Noted — will tag release notes as draft until then.
olivia (growth): I'll prep the webinar sign-up page and a short landing that links to the blog + docs. Share the signup for social creative.
sophie (docs): Put the final docs link in #marketing when ready. I'll also pin a small FAQ about quantized model tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: canary start=1782060600 (Mon 23:30 PT), full-ramp=1782096000 (Tue 04:00 PT).
mia (marketing): OK team — action items: Kevin finish changelog + bench config (TODAY EOD), Sophie publish docs draft (TODAY EOD), Olivia landing + lead routing ready (Mon morning), Grant to own webinar agenda. I'll assemble blog draft and send for review Mon 09:00 PT. :raised_hands:
kevin (eng): On it.
sophie (docs): On it.
grant (product): I'll create webinar outline and share a calendar invite.
olivia (growth): I'll route leads to sales + set Drift tag.
mia (marketing): Thanks all — thumbs up here when your piece is live so I can finalize the post. :thumbsup:
